title: FRT G01-G30 run lease
description: A time-bounded right to execute one claimed run. Distinct from elmos.runner-job-lease.v1, which leases generic ELMOS jobs: an FRT lease is embedded in the run result itself and is the only thing that makes a RUNNING run legitimate. Once it expires the control plane reclaims the run, so a runner that dies silently can never leave a run stuck in RUNNING.

runnerId.description: Identity that claimed the run. Only this identity may heartbeat or complete it.

expiresAt.description: claimedAt plus the requested lease seconds, bounded to [30, 86400]. Default 900; override per claim or with ELMOS_FRT_LEASE_SECONDS.

heartbeatCount.description: Number of successful renewals. Each renewal bumps the run version, so a runner must carry the version returned by its last heartbeat into the next call.

$comment: Lifecycle: claim issues the lease; heartbeat extends it (holder only, never after expiry); complete, cancel and retry clear it; sweepExpiredLeases reclaims RUNNING runs whose lease expired, emitting RUN_LEASE_EXPIRED and outcome BLOCKED_BY_LEASE_EXPIRED. An expired lease cannot be revived - the run must be retried, which creates a fresh claim.
